title: FIFA Soccer 96
overview:
Phenomenal Graphics. Breathtaking Gameplay. The Future of Sports Gaming Is Here!

FIFA Soccer 96 takes you out of your chair, onto the field, and into the action. Get ready to devastate your opponent with mind-boggling fakes, blistering breakaways, and precision passing. Perfect those heart-stopping one-timers and game-clenching penalty kicks. Complete the experience with authentic play-by-play. It doesn't get better than this!!!

- Thousands of SGI-rendered player animations
- Multiple camera angles
- The voice of soccer, John Motson, calls the action
- CD-quality sound effects encoded in Dolby Surround Sound
- Full save capabilities
- An arsenal of offensive weapons: Bicycle Kicks, Slide Tackles, Diving Headers, Sprint Dribbles, Give and Gos, Crossover Fakes, Rainbow Kicks
- Custom teams: Create your own dream team
